title: feat: let REST agents sign in with the device flow
author: xiaotian1171

gist.summary: Updated the pollinations-api Agent Skill so a fresh REST agent can guide a user through OAuth 2.0 device sign-in instead of asking them to copy a dashboard key. The agent requests a code from POST /api/device/code, shows the approval URL, and polls POST /api/oauth/token while honoring interval and slow_down. After approval, the instructions save the credential to a private 0600 file and export it from there rather than printing or pasting it into chat. The flow reuses existing Pollinations endpoints and requires no new service or credential.
